summary: The diff modifies Layout.tsx to add an Admin Panel navigation link using `useIsCallerAdmin` with the condition `!adminLoading && isAdmin === true`. The implementation includes the link in the desktop nav, mobile menu, and also adds a prominent header button. The core requirement (REQ-1) appears to be substantially implemented, with admin-only conditional rendering, `/admin` route navigation, and presence in both desktop and mobile contexts.

hallucinated_features.description: A prominent 'Admin Panel' button added directly in the header as a standalone element outside of the standard nav links and mobile menu, visible on all screen sizes.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 specifies the link must appear in the desktop navigation and the mobile menu. The build request does not request an extra standalone header button beyond those two placements. The file summary explicitly notes 'adds a prominent Admin Panel button visible on all screen sizes in the header (not just in the nav or overflow menu)' indicating an additional unrequested UI element was added.
